name: PRISMA screening flow
author: PrismNext
description: Four-stage PRISMA-style flow: identification → screening → eligibility → included, with two exclusion boxes. Counts live in the label macros.

parameters.name: \identlabel
parameters.meaning: identification box (use \\ before the n= line)

operations.summary: edit the matching label macro; put the real n= on the second line
add another drop box to the right of a stage and a flow arrow
change a style's palette name; never a hex/stock color

invariants: every n= comes from a run or a screening log — do not invent counts
colors only via the five palette names
